description: This file contains helper functions for managing distributed checkpointing in PyTorch, including comparison, merging, and creation of read/write plans for tensor and sharded tensor metadata, as well as functions for initializing state dictionaries with distributed tensors.

methods.name: _compare_save_plans
methods.description: Compares two SavePlan objects for equality based on their attributes and contained items.

methods.name: _contains_usable_plan
methods.description: Checks if any plan in a list of SavePlans is marked as usable.

methods.name: _merge_delta_local_plans
methods.description: Merges cached and delta SavePlans into a single plan, preferring delta plans if usable.

methods.name: _create_chunk_from_tensor
methods.description: Creates ChunkStorageMetadata from a tensor's shape.

methods.name: _chunk_for_shard
methods.description: Creates ChunkStorageMetadata from a shard's metadata.

methods.name: _sharded_tensor_metadata
methods.description: Generates TensorWriteData for a sharded tensor and its shard metadata.

methods.name: _create_write_items_for_dtensor
methods.description: Creates WriteItem for a DTensor, including local shape and offset computations.

methods.name: _create_write_item_for_shard
methods.description: Creates a WriteItem for a specific shard of a ShardedTensor.

methods.name: _create_write_item_for_tensor
methods.description: Creates a WriteItem for a standard tensor.

methods.name: _create_write_item_for_bytesio
methods.description: Creates a WriteItem for byte stream objects.

methods.name: _create_read_item_for_byteio
methods.description: Creates a ReadItem for byte stream objects.

methods.name: _create_read_item_for_tensor
methods.description: Creates a ReadItem for tensor data.

methods.name: create_read_items_for_chunk_list
methods.description: Generates a list of ReadItems to load chunks based on checkpoint metadata and local chunks, applying resharding logic.

methods.name: _create_default_metadata_only_plan
methods.description: Creates a SavePlan with write items for all entries in a state dict, handling DTensor, ShardedTensor, and tensors.

methods.name: _create_write_items
methods.description: Creates write items for an object, delegating based on object type.

methods.name: _create_chunk_from_dtensor
methods.description: Creates ChunkStorageMetadata from a DTensor.

methods.name: _create_chunk_list
methods.description: Creates a list of ChunkStorageMetadata from a tensor, DTensor, or ShardedTensor.

methods.name: _create_read_items
methods.description: Creates read items for a tensor or checkpoint metadata, handling different storage types.

methods.name: _init_state_dict
methods.description: Initializes tensors in a state dict, converting meta tensors to local tensors with proper device placement.

methods.name: _iterate_state_dict
methods.description: Recursively applies functions to tensors within a state dict, supporting DTensor, ShardedTensor, and standard tensors.
